austin.summary: Austin, you drafted 5th and the back half of your board saved you. Linnea and Jenna are gone, but Eric at pick #16 and Carter are both sitting at 14 pts, rank 1 of 21, and they're hauling you to rank 3 of 5 with 38 counted points. The leader has 56. There are 34 points still on the table and 2 of 4 still in the game. You're in contention — stay loud.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric, your pick #16 steal, is tied at the very top with 14 pts and a rank of 1 of 21 — a mental health counselor reading the room better than anyone on that beach.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna at pick #6 was the reach, 4 pts and rank 17 of 21 before her 4th-place exit in Ep 4, and Linnea's 6 pts and Ep 5 boot left you with a Draft GPA of 2.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Carter and Eric are both on Tovuto, so watch what happens when that tribe splits up — your whole 38 points rides on two guys currently standing side by side.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this season — Aaliyah at pick #3, gone in Episode 1, First Blood badge and all — and that's a tough way to open a draft. A 2.25 draft GPA tells the story, and at rank 4 of 5 with 32 counted points, you're eliminated from contention while the leader sits on 56. But Cristian at pick #8 is the number one scorer in this entire pool. That's a steal, and he's still out there.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian — fun, chaotic, loud, and ranked 1 of 21 with 14 pts — is the best pick anyone made at #8, and he's your last castaway standing.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah went home first at 0 pts, rank 21 of 21, and that pick #3 grade F is the hole this roster never climbed out of.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are still 22 points on the table, and after a +8 high in Ep 7 and a +2 low in Ep 6, every move Cristian makes is worth watching.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick and you built a Tovuto wall — Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda, all three still standing, all three tied at 14 pts, rank 1 of 21. That's 45 counted points, rank 2 of 5, with 46 points still on the table and the leader sitting at 56. Your roster owns the hardware too: 2 necklaces, 2 idols found. Ep 7 gave you +12. You are absolutely in this.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda Cox was the leftover at pick #21 and she's rank 1 of 21 with 14 pts and a grade A — the steal of this entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 went out 3rd in Ep 3 with 3 pts and a grade F, and Rob's quit left you with a 2 pts score you're dropping under the best-4 rule — that's a Draft GPA of 2.4.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Three Tovuto players deadlocked at 14 pts apiece means the moment that tribe gets split up, somebody has to separate from the pack — and your worst week was Ep 4 at +3, so the floor is real.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted from the second slot and built a cast full of personality — crisis management, a Division I hustler, a voice actress, a pro wrestler — and the fire went out fast. You sit at rank 5 of 5 with 31 counted points, 0 of 4 still in the game, 0 points still on the table, and the leader at 56. Ep 7 gave you a +7 high; Ep 8 gave you +0. Your Torch Collector badge says it all: 4 torches snuffed.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger led your roster with 12 pts, ranking 12 of 21 and going out 9th & 10th as 1st & 2nd jury members after a lifetime of applying since season one.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani was gone 2nd voted out in Ep 2 with just 1 pts, ranking 20 of 21 — a Day 5 exit that your draft GPA of 1.25 never recovered from.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Brady Booker at pick #19 was your steal of the draft, grading an A with 11 pts, and your crew still walks away as Idol Whisperer with 2 found — that's the legacy to brag about at the next family draft.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted 4th and somehow walked away with an entire tribe intact — four for four, still in the game, rank 1 of 5 with 56 counted points. A 3.75 draft GPA, Untouchable, Merge Machine, Wire-to-Wire, Idol Whisperer. Eleven boots have come and gone and not one of them was yours. You opened quietly at Ep 1 with +4, then detonated in Ep 7 with +16. That, my friend, is a draft.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: There's no single hero here — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are each sitting on 14 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced four-headed monster.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Every egg is in the Tovuto basket and Lewis carries the only B grade on the sheet, so any crack in that bloc hits you four ways at once.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: 58 points are still on the table and the leader has 56 — keep your eyes on that Idol Whisperer badge, because 2 found already means your people are digging.
